 Trey Murphy 
 NOP 
 Forward 
 #25 
 Personalize your Rotoworld feed by favoriting players 
 Trey Murphy (knee) is out for Monday’s game against the Warriors. 
 Monday’s game will be the fifth Murphy has missed due to patellar tendinopathy in both knees. Saddiq Bey has started the last two games and should remain in that role. He’s worth streaming, especially for managers needing points and three-pointers. 
 Zion Williamson 
 NOP 
 Forward 
 #1 
 Zion Williamson led the Pelicans with 24 points (9-of-16 FGs, 4-of-8 FTs), six rebounds, two assists, two blocks and two three-pointers in a 116-108 loss to the Nuggets on Saturday. 
 Zion has taken major strides this season, and it has helped in fantasy hoops. Unfortunately, this was the third game this season that he failed to record a steal, which has been a strength for him, and he had his worst night at the free throw line this season, though he has improved overall this year. He made up for it by matching his season high for both three-pointers and blocks. Despite the lack of team success, Zion continues to fill up the box score. 
 Saddiq Bey 
 NOP 
 Forward 
 #41 
 Saddiq Bey had himself a night with 30 points (12-of-19 FGs, 9-of-10 FTs), 10 rebounds, a block, and six 3-pointers in the 142-111 loss to the Grizzlies. 
 Saddiq Bey is going to be in charge of helping Zion take up shots with no Dejounte Murray on the team. Once Trey Murphy comes back, he may be back to his sixth man role, but until that time, it would be good to add Saddiq Bey in redraft leagues if you haven’t already. He’ll score, he’ll get you some rebounds, hit some 3’s, and not do much else, but he should be in line to get a lot of those things. 
 Zion Williamson 
 NOP 
 Forward 
 #1 
 Zion Williamson scored 22 points (12-of-19 FGs, 9-of-10 FTs), five rebounds, four assists, three steals, and a block against the Grizzlies. 
 With one less high usage player in the fold for the Pelicans, Zion Williamson is going to have more pressure to bring the Pelicans to wins. They need him to be the star and his value and role is relatively secure. He could be in line for some big-time games as the most talented offensive player on the team. 
 Zion Williamson 
 NOP 
 Forward 
 #1 
 The Pelicans will start Jeremiah Fears, Herbert Jones, Saddiq Bey, Zion Williamson, and DeAndre Jordan on Friday against the Grizzlies. 
 There have been two changes to the starting lineup from the past game against the Nets. Saddiq Bey is starting in place of Dejounte Murray who is reportedly not playing for the Pelicans again, and DeAndre Jordan will replace Karlo Matković in the starting lineup. 
 Trey Murphy 
 NOP 
 Forward 
 #25 
 Trey Murphy (knee) and Yves Missi (knee) are out for Friday’s matchup with the Grizzlies. 
 After receiving doubtful tags on Thursday, both players are unsurprisingly unavailable against Memphis. With Dejounte Murray (ankle) doubtful, expect Saddiq Bey, Karlo Matković and Herb Jones to see bumps in playing time. 
 Trey Murphy 
 NOP 
 Forward 
 #25 
 Trey Murphy (knee) and Yves Missi (knee) are doubtful for Friday’s matchup with the Grizzlies. 
 Murphy will miss a third straight game, and Missi will be sidelined for an 11th straight. With the pair expected to sit out against Memphis, Saddiq Bey and Karlo Matkovic should continue to handle additional playing time. 
 Zion Williamson 
 NOP 
 Forward 
 #1 
 Zion Williamson put up 29 points (8-of-14 FGs, 12-of-14 FTs), four rebounds, two assists, a block and a three in loss to Nets. 
 Zion Williamson was the only player on the team that could do anything consistently against Nets in this one. It’s great he got to the line as much as he did and he hit most of them. Outside of him, they couldn’t score consistently which isn’t great for getting wins. The Pelicans’ next opportunity to play will be against the Pelicans on Friday. 
 Zion Williamson 
 NOP 
 Forward 
 #1 
 The Pelicans will start Jeremiah Fears, Dejounte Murray, Herbert Jones, Zion Williamson, and Karlo Matkovic against the Nets on Wednesday. 
 Zion Williamson will return to the stating lineup and Saddiq Bey will head to the bench. Saddiq is still a good points streamer with no Trey Murphy available in Wednesday’s game. 
 Trey Murphy 
 NOP 
 Forward 
 #25 
 Trey Murphy (knee) is out for Wednesday’s game against the Nets. 
 Downgraded from probable to doubtful late Wednesday morning, Murphy will miss a second straight game. Saddiq Bey started Monday’s loss to the Warriors but offered little production. However, Wednesday’s matchup should be a better one for him.

 Cryer and Horford will be moving into the starting unit, with De’Anthony Melton and Will Richard heading to the bench. Cryer is getting his first start of the season after having 20 points, six assists and six three-pointers over his last three games while averaging 14.3 points and 3.7 triples per game during this stretch.
